Usage: resecta-data build [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Generate Phase 1+ artifacts into build/.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  adversarial             Build adversarial pattern fixtures.
  bloom                   Build surnames.bloom + given-names.bloom + gazetteer_manifest.json.
  bundle-size             Build the bundle-size instrumentation probe.
  calibrate               Phase 3b calibration artifacts produced from Swift-side dumps.
  classifier              Build doctype keywords and preset threshold candidates.
  context                 Build the per-category positive context-keyword gazetteer.
  corpus                  Build the G8 synthetic document corpus (one file per profile).
  demographics            Build the demographic coverage report from the current name corpora.
  eval-baseline           Derive the detection baseline + learned-term headroom from the Swift...
  eval-compare            Decide the four-clause before/after predicate from two derived...
  eval-compare-documents  Decide the four-clause before/after predicate over document rows.
  eval-documents          Derive the document-level Site-B eval from the H1.2 harness JSONs.
  eval-sitegap            Join the detector-site and Site-B derived baselines into the site gap.
  fuzz                    Build fuzz payload catalogs.
  g8-bucket-recall        Build the G8 bucket-stratified recall artifact.
  gazetteers              Build non-Bloom gazetteer artifacts.
  negative-corpus         Build the deterministic no-PII negative corpus (the baseline FP...
  rules                   Build the PII detector rule-ID catalog.
  vectors                 Build Phase 1 test vectors (checksummed + structural PII detectors).
  zip-scf                 Build the ZIP → SCF → state table from a HUD crosswalk CSV.
